subject: general
question: In which of the following locations was the PHDCCI International Week scheduled to be held in March 2025, which is postponed now?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Greater Noida**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI) had scheduled its International Week in **Greater Noida** for March 2025.
 
• This event was planned to bring together global leaders, policymakers, and industry experts for discussions on international trade and economic collaboration.
 
• Greater Noida is a hub for business and industrial activities, making it an ideal location for such international events.
 
• The event has been postponed due to unforeseen circumstances, with new dates expected to be announced soon.
 
• PHDCCI is one of India’s leading chambers of commerce, established in 1905, promoting trade, industry, and economic development across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About PHDCCI:**

 
 
• The PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI) was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• It serves as a platform for business networking and policy advocacy for various industries.
 
• PHDCCI organizes seminars, expos, and international events to foster global trade collaborations.
 
 
 
• **Greater Noida as an Event Destination:**
 
 
• Greater Noida is part of the National Capital Region (NCR) of India.
 
• It is known for its well-planned infrastructure, industrial zones, and proximity to Delhi.
 
• The city hosts several international expos and conferences due to its connectivity and facilities.
 
 
 
• **International Trade Events:**
 
 
• International trade events foster partnerships between businesses across borders.
 
• They provide a platform for showcasing innovations, products, and services to a global audience.
 
• Such events help in understanding global market trends and exploring export opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Economic Impact of Postponements:**
 
 
• Postponements of major events can impact local economies and stakeholders.
 
• Rescheduling ensures safety and better preparedness for organizers and participants.
 
• Communication of new dates and plans is crucial to maintain trust among stakeholders.
